summary.text: Jay Trumbull has represented District 2 in the Florida Senate since being elected in 2022, after serving in the Florida House of Representatives from 2014 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Trumbull is a business owner who was born in Panama City, Florida.
Trumbull's Senate biography lists Auburn University (2011) under education.
